replay.description: Leader-q decollision (Wave A interaction audit §1b): <leader>q belongs to session.queued_prompts (v2 keybind.ts:131); app.exit keeps ctrl+c/ctrl+d. With text in the prompt the app.exit binding is disabled and the chord suspends the textarea (D-02 — the q is dispatched to the queue manager, not typed, and the draft survives); once the draft is cleared, ctrl+c dispatches app.exit and tears the renderer down
replay.source: test/app-lifecycle.test.tsx (exit ordering) + src/config/keybind.ts (app.exit = 'ctrl+c,ctrl+d' after the Wave A decollision, session.queued_prompts = '<leader>q', leader default ctrl+x) + src/app.tsx app.exit layer enabled only while the prompt is empty + terminal-pane.tsx:144 (focused surfaces skip leader strokes — the chord fires over a non-empty draft)
